# SpaceWise

SpaceWise is a smart storage management application that helps users manage and clean up Gmail and Google Drive storage.

## Main Pages

- [SpaceWise Home](https://spacewise-one.vercel.app/)
- [SpaceWise Login](https://spacewise-one.vercel.app/login)

## Features

- Gmail storage analysis and cleanup
- Google Drive storage analysis
- Duplicate file detection
- Drive trash management
- Storage analytics
- AI-powered organization

## Website

- [SpaceWise](https://spacewise-one.vercel.app/)
